records.title: Use Vendetta for world-building
records.text:
I added Vendetta to the [Mysterious Hearts game guide](C:/Users/ryanl/Documents/ChatGPT/Game%20Creator/Mysterious%20Hearts%20-%20RPG%20Game.md#L11) as source material for Winterfield. The guide makes one rule explicit: **there are no Awakened in Mysterious Hearts.** I also added that rule to the [live dialogue directions](C:/Users/ryanl/Documents/ChatGPT/Game%20Creator/ai_directions.txt#L4) so it applies during play.

The guide now identifies details you can draw on later, including Vendetta’s 2050 setting, Tyler Harding and Mahmoud at the Iron Circle, and the organisations that might surface during Garrett’s search. Winterfield’s exact year and Charles’s whereabouts are still open.

For Charles, I included one optional lead: someone at his old workplace recognises his handwriting on a delivery slip dated after he left. That gives Garrett something he can investigate and a reason to decide whether to confide in Rei, while leaving you free to choose what happened to his brother.

records.title: Use Vendetta for world-building
records.text:
Charles is undercover inside the Syndicate in *Mysterious Hearts*. Garrett doesn’t know, and the game keeps that fact out of his dialogue prompts.

While playing as Garrett, select **Find Charles** to open a message from Mei, a former dispatch clerk who worked with his brother in Hong Kong. She’s found a delivery slip dated eleven days after Charles left his job. Garrett recognises the crooked crossbar on the handwritten **H**. If he asks Mei for the receiving copy, the stamp gives him his first place to investigate: **West Pier Cold Storage, Hong Kong**. There’s no driver’s signature, so Garrett still has to work out whether Charles was there himself.

The lead works in new and existing Garrett saves. I played through both steps, verified that progress survives a reload, and ran all 74 existing tests successfully.
